processors.description: Enrich Argo CD event: images, version, owner, source, history

dql.script:
parse app, "JSON:app_full"

| fieldsAdd argocd.app.images = app_full[status][summary][images]
| fieldsAdd app_images = arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(not contains(argocd.app.images[], "dynatrace"), argocd.app.images[])))
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.image = app_images[0]
| fieldsAdd img_colon = lastIndexOf(argocd.app.image, ":"), img_slash = lastIndexOf(argocd.app.image, "/"), img_at = indexOf(argocd.app.image, "@")
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.image.tag = if(img_at >= 0, substring(argocd.app.image, from: img_at + 1), else: if(img_colon > img_slash, substring(argocd.app.image, from: img_colon + 1)))

| fieldsAdd argocd.app.version = coalesce(argocd.app.image.tag, argocd.app.version)
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.owner = coalesce(argocd.app.owner, app_full[spec][project])
| fieldsAdd vcs.ref.base.name = coalesce(vcs.ref.base.name, app_full[spec][source][targetRevision])
| fieldsAdd vcs.repository.url.full = coalesce(vcs.repository.url.full, app_full[spec][source][repoURL])

| fieldsAdd argocd.sync.initiated_by = coalesce(app_full[status][operationState][operation][initiatedBy][username], if(app_full[status][operationState][operation][initiatedBy][automated] == true, "automated"))

| fieldsAdd app_history = app_full[status][history]
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.deployment_count = arrayLast(app_history)[id]
| fieldsAdd vcs.ref.previous.revision = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(iIndex() == arraySize(app_history) - 2, app_history[][revision]))))

| fieldsAdd cicd.deployment.ingress.url = app_full[status][summary][externalURLs][0]
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.source.path = app_full[spec][source][path]
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.source.type = app_full[status][sourceType]
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.helm.release = app_full[spec][source][helm][releaseName]
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.helm.value_files = app_full[spec][source][helm][valueFiles]
| fieldsAdd tracking_id = app_full[metadata][annotations]["argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id"]
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.parent = if(indexOf(tracking_id, ":") > 0, substring(tracking_id, from: 0, to: indexOf(tracking_id, ":")))
| fieldsAdd argocd.sync.auto = isNotNull(app_full[spec][syncPolicy][automated])
| fieldsAdd argocd.sync.self_heal = app_full[spec][syncPolicy][automated][selfHeal]
| fieldsAdd argocd.sync.prune = app_full[spec][syncPolicy][automated][prune]
| fieldsAdd argocd.sync.retry_limit = app_full[spec][syncPolicy][retry][limit]
| fieldsAdd sync_resources = app_full[status][operationState][syncResult][resources]
| fieldsAdd argocd.sync.resources = iCollectArray(concat(sync_resources[][kind], "/", sync_resources[][name]))
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.health.since = toTimestamp(app_full[status][health][lastTransitionTime])
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.created = toTimestamp(app_full[metadata][creationTimestamp])

| fieldsRemove app_full, app_images, img_colon, img_slash, img_at, app_history, tracking_id, sync_resources
